story.title: TGO – Tenant Onboarding Workflow and Lifecycle Refactor

tokens.ENV: Build containing US 1407344 deployed to QA (TGO Dashboard https://trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com/tgo).
tokens.ADMIN: User has an Admin role with Tenant create/edit and Region/Site create/edit permissions.
tokens.RO: User A has a role with only the 'View TGO Settings' permission (US 1411910) - no create/edit/delete permissions.
tokens.BC_TI: Breadcrumb: TGO Dashboard (/tgo) > Tenants > + (Add Tenant) > Tenant Onboarding > Tenant Information tab.
tokens.BC_RS: Breadcrumb: TGO Dashboard (/tgo) > Tenants > <Tenant> > Tenant Onboarding > Regions/Sites tab.
tokens.PENDING: A Pending tenant exists whose Tenant Information was saved via Save & Next and which has no Regions/Sites yet.
tokens.EXIST: At least one pre-existing Active tenant created before this deployment, with >=1 Site and a working Trilogy connection; its Tenant ID, Site list, Trilogy Base URL and status were recorded before deployment.
tokens.TD: Tenant Name: QA_TGO_Onb_<yyyyMMddHHmm>; Tenant Description: QA onboarding workflow test; Trilogy Go Domain: trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com
tokens.REG: Region Name: QA_Region_East; Trilogy Base URL: loyalty-atm-a02.purplecheckpoint.com; Region Description: QA east region
tokens.SITE: Site: QA_Site_01 with the existing mandatory Site fields populated per the current Site form
OPENP: Locate the tenant from Preconditions and open it (Edit / Continue Onboarding action)
tokens.FILLTI: Enter Tenant Name, Tenant Description and Trilogy Go Domain from Test Data

reqs.text: Tenant onboarding uses workflow/tab navigation containing (1) Tenant Information and (2) Regions/Sites.
reqs.cond: Onboarding opens as an ordered tab/workflow with Tenant Information then Regions/Sites.

reqs.text: Save & Next functionality works correctly (persists current step and advances to the next step).
reqs.cond: Save & Next saves the step data exactly once and advances; failures keep the user on the step with data retained.

reqs.text: Tenant initially saves in Pending state and does not become Active immediately.
reqs.cond: First save of a new tenant creates it with status Pending (UI + persistence).

reqs.text: Tenant transitions to Active after onboarding completion.
reqs.cond: Pending -> Active only after all required steps and Region/Site requirements are complete.

reqs.text: Users can continue onboarding later (return to a Pending tenant and resume).
reqs.cond: A Pending tenant can be re-opened and resumed at the next incomplete step with saved data prefilled.

reqs.text: Existing Tenants remain unaffected / functional after deployment.
reqs.cond: Pre-existing tenants keep Active status, sites, settings and connectivity after deployment and after edits.

reqs.text: Region/Site management is accessible within the onboarding flow.
reqs.cond: Regions and Sites can be created/viewed from the Regions/Sites step of onboarding.

reqs.text: Tenant Information section contains Tenant Name, Tenant Description, Trilogy Go Domain, consistent with current onboarding fields.
reqs.cond: Tenant Information fields exist and validate consistently with the existing Add Tenant form.

reqs.text: Tenant becomes Active only after required onboarding steps are completed and Region/Site configuration requirements are satisfied; incomplete onboarding shall not activate the Tenant.
reqs.cond: Every incomplete combination of steps leaves the tenant Pending.

reqs.text: Users shall not bypass required onboarding steps.
reqs.cond: Later steps/activation cannot be reached through UI, deep link, or direct API before required steps are done.

reqs.text: Tenant onboarding progress shall persist between sessions.
reqs.cond: Saved progress survives logout/login, browser change, refresh and session timeout.

reqs.text: Region management and Site management are consolidated under the Tenant onboarding experience instead of disconnected pages.
reqs.cond: Region/Site management is reached through the tenant, not via a disconnected page.

reqs.text: Onboarding visually guides the user through Tenant setup, Region setup and Site setup.
reqs.cond: A visible progress indicator shows current/completed steps.

reqs.text: Existing Trilogy workflow/tab patterns are reused instead of new onboarding components.
reqs.cond: Workflow tabs look and behave like existing Trilogy tab patterns.

reqs.text: Sites must always belong to a Region; orphan Sites shall not exist.
reqs.cond: Site creation inside onboarding requires a Region.

reqs.text: Duplicate Region names within the same Tenant shall not be allowed.
reqs.cond: Region name uniqueness is enforced per tenant during onboarding.

reqs.text: Region contains Region Name, Trilogy Base URL/domain, Region Description; empty state message and Add Region action are shown when no Regions exist; nested Region/Site grid with expand/collapse.
reqs.cond: Regions/Sites step shows empty state, Region modal fields and nested grid.

reqs.text: Existing Tenants/Sites migrate to the Region architecture: existing Site mappings, Trilogy Base URL relationships and active Tenants preserved; no orphan Sites.
reqs.cond: Post-deployment data for existing tenants is intact and hierarchical.

reqs.text: Users with only View TGO Settings can view Tenant onboarding details and Region/Site hierarchy but cannot modify onboarding configuration, Regions or Sites.
reqs.cond: Read-only users see onboarding read-only; writes are blocked in UI and API.

reqs.text: An already existing Tenant cannot be created again.
reqs.cond: Duplicate tenant creation is rejected in the new workflow.

reqs.src: Wiki (Tenants tab + icon) / sibling US 1411909 (/tgo routing)
reqs.text: Onboarding is launched from TGO (/tgo) > Tenants > + icon.
reqs.cond: The Add Tenant entry point opens the new workflow.

reqs.text: Tenants created in TGO are onboarded from the Trilogy platform (System > Tenant > Search by Trilogy Domain + Trilogy Go Domain > Onboard > Check Connectivity).
reqs.cond: Downstream Trilogy onboarding/connectivity works for new (completed) and existing tenants; Pending handling is defined.

business_rules: BR1: A newly created tenant is Pending, never Active on creation (REQ-003).
BR2: Pending -> Active only when Tenant Information is complete AND Region/Site requirements are satisfied (REQ-004, REQ-009).
BR3: Required steps cannot be bypassed (REQ-010).
BR4: Onboarding progress persists between sessions and can be resumed (REQ-005, REQ-011).
BR5: Existing tenants keep functioning and are not moved back to Pending (REQ-006, REQ-018).
BR6: Sites always belong to a Region; Region names are unique per tenant (REQ-015, REQ-016).
BR7: A tenant that already exists cannot be created again (REQ-020).
functional_requirements: Region/Site management inside onboarding (REQ-007, REQ-012, REQ-015..REQ-017).
non_functional_requirements: Usability: guided step indicator, reuse of Trilogy tab patterns (REQ-013, REQ-014).
Reliability/Recovery: no duplicate or partial tenants on failure/double submit (REQ-002).
Security: no bypass through deep links or API; read-only permission enforcement (REQ-010, REQ-019).
Backward compatibility: migration of existing tenants (REQ-006, REQ-018).
No performance NFR stated (see Missing Requirements).
dependencies: Successor US 1411893 (Hierarchical Region and Site Management, Dev Review) - provides the nested Region/Site grid, Region/Site modals and validations used by the Regions/Sites step.
Sibling US 1411909 (Region Architecture, Backend and Migration, Closed) - lifecycle state storage, Region entity, migration of existing tenants, /tgo routing.
Sibling US 1411910 (Permissions and Access, Ready for Development) - View TGO Settings permission; REQ-019 cases are blocked until it is delivered.
Trilogy platform tenant onboarding (System > Tenant) consumes TGO tenants (wiki).
PR 185578 linked to the story (not reviewed - artifact link only).
constraints: Story is In Development; live UI exploration disabled - exact labels (tab names, button text, status labels, messages) must be confirmed against the build.
Task children 1471705, 1488339, 1488340, 1488342 skipped per policy; their titles indicate a Wizard mode for creation and a Non-Wizard mode for updating a tenant.
Full Region/Site CRUD, reassignment and deletion rules are owned by US 1411893 and only exercised here as far as onboarding needs.
assumptions: A1: Completing onboarding requires at least one Region with at least one Site (AC does not define the minimum).
A2: Regions/Sites step is not reachable for a brand-new tenant until Tenant Information is saved.
A3: Editing an existing tenant uses a non-wizard mode (free tab navigation) - from Task 1488342 title.
A4: Activation happens automatically on completion of the last required step (or via an explicit Complete/Finish action if present).
A5: Field limits/format rules for Tenant Name and Trilogy Go Domain are those of the current Add Tenant form.

missing: No explicit definition of 'onboarding completion' (minimum Regions/Sites, is a Finish/Complete action required?).
No field-level validation rules (max lengths, allowed characters, Trilogy Go Domain format, is Tenant Description mandatory?).
No definition of how Pending tenants behave in the Trilogy platform onboarding search, Service Activity Report and TGO Settings.
No rule for Active tenants whose last Region/Site is soft-deleted (revert to Pending or stay Active).
No audit/logging requirement for tenant creation and Pending -> Active transitions.
No performance NFR for the Regions/Sites step with large hierarchies.
No rule for Pending tenants that are abandoned (expiry/cleanup) or for deleting a Pending tenant.

cases.sc: AC1 - Add Tenant Opens Workflow With Ordered Tabs
cases.cond: Onboarding opens as a tab/workflow with Tenant Information first and Regions/Sites second
s: {{OPEN}}
Observe the workflow header/tab bar
cases.e: Tenant Onboarding workflow opens (not the old single Add Tenant form). Tabs appear in order: 1) Tenant Information, 2) Regions/Sites. Tenant Information is the active tab and its fields are empty.

cases.sc: AC1 - Step Indicator Shows Tenant Region Site Progress
cases.cond: Workflow visually guides the user through Tenant, Region and Site setup
s: {{OPEN}}
Note the step indicator state
{{FILLTI}} and click 'Save & Next'
Note the step indicator state
Add a Region and a Site under it from Test Data
Note the step indicator state
cases.e: Indicator always highlights the current step (Tenant setup -> Region setup -> Site setup) and marks completed steps as done; it never shows a later step as complete before its data is saved.

cases.sc: AC1 - Regions Sites Tab Locked Before Tenant Information Saved
cases.cond: Regions/Sites step cannot be opened for a new tenant before Tenant Information is saved
s: {{OPEN}}
Without entering data click the 'Regions/Sites' tab
{{FILLTI}} but do NOT click Save & Next
Click the 'Regions/Sites' tab again
cases.e: Regions/Sites tab is disabled or shows a message to complete Tenant Information first; the user stays on Tenant Information; no tenant is created in the Tenants list.

cases.sc: Entry Point - Tenants Plus Icon Under /tgo
cases.cond: Add Tenant entry point under /tgo launches the new onboarding workflow
s: Navigate to https://trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com/tgo and log in
Click 'Tenants' in the side menu
Click the '+' (Add Tenant) icon
Check the browser URL
cases.e: Tenants list loads under /tgo; '+' opens the Tenant Onboarding workflow on the Tenant Information tab and the URL stays under the /tgo route.

cases.sc: UI Consistency - Workflow Reuses Trilogy Tab Pattern
cases.cond: Workflow tabs reuse the existing Trilogy workflow/tab pattern
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{BC_TI}} An existing Trilogy/TGO tabbed page is available for comparison (e.g. TGO Settings under Admin Configuration).
s: {{OPEN}}
Compare tab styling, active/inactive states, button placement and spacing with the existing tabbed page
Resize the browser to 1366x768 and 1920x1080
cases.e: Onboarding tabs use the same look and behaviour as the existing Trilogy tab component (styles, active indicator, button placement); no clipped or overlapping elements at both resolutions.

cases.sc: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation Through Workflow
cases.cond: Workflow tabs, fields and Save & Next are keyboard operable with correct focus order
s: {{OPEN}}
Using only Tab/Shift+Tab move through the tabs, Tenant Name, Tenant Description, Trilogy Go Domain and Save & Next
Fill the fields from Test Data with the keyboard and press Enter/Space on 'Save & Next'
With NVDA running, move focus to the tab bar
cases.e: Focus order follows the visual order with a visible focus ring; Save & Next works from the keyboard and moves focus to the Regions/Sites step; the screen reader announces field labels, required state and the active tab/step.

cases.sc: Tenant Information - Fields Present And Consistent
cases.cond: Tenant Information shows Tenant Name, Tenant Description and Trilogy Go Domain consistent with the existing form
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{BC_TI}} Screenshot of the pre-deployment Add Tenant form available for comparison.
s: {{OPEN}}
Inspect the Tenant Information tab fields, labels and required markers
cases.e: Exactly the fields Tenant Name, Tenant Description and Trilogy Go Domain are shown with labels, placeholders and required markers matching the pre-deployment Add Tenant form; no Region/Site fields are on this tab.

cases.sc: Tenant Information - Blank Tenant Name Rejected
cases.cond: Save & Next is blocked when Tenant Name is empty
cases.data: Tenant Name: <blank>; Tenant Description: QA onboarding workflow test; Trilogy Go Domain: trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com
s: {{OPEN}}
Leave Tenant Name empty and fill the other fields from Test Data
Click 'Save & Next'
cases.e: Inline required-field validation is shown on Tenant Name; user stays on Tenant Information; no tenant (Pending or otherwise) is created in the Tenants list.

cases.sc: Tenant Information - Blank Trilogy Go Domain Rejected
cases.cond: Save & Next is blocked when Trilogy Go Domain is empty
cases.data: Tenant Name: QA_TGO_Onb_<yyyyMMddHHmm>; Tenant Description: QA onboarding workflow test; Trilogy Go Domain: <blank>
s: {{OPEN}}
Fill Tenant Name and Description, leave Trilogy Go Domain empty
Click 'Save & Next'
cases.e: Required-field validation is shown on Trilogy Go Domain; user stays on Tenant Information; no tenant is created.

cases.sc: Tenant Information - Invalid Trilogy Go Domain Formats
cases.cond: Trilogy Go Domain rejects malformed values with the same rules as the existing form
cases.data: Trilogy Go Domain values: (a) 'trilogy go qa01' (spaces) (b) 'trilogy-go-qa01..purplecheckpoint.com' (c) 'ftp://trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com' (d) 'https://trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com/' (protocol + trailing slash)
s: {{OPEN}}
Enter a valid Tenant Name and Description
Enter value (a) in Trilogy Go Domain and click 'Save & Next'
Repeat step 5 for values (b), (c) and (d)
cases.e: Values (a)-(c) are rejected with a format validation message and no tenant is created; value (d) is either normalised to the bare domain or rejected exactly as the pre-deployment Add Tenant form did (record behaviour); no malformed domain is persisted.

cases.sc: Tenant Information - Tenant Name Length Boundaries
cases.cond: Tenant Name accepts max length and rejects max+1
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{BC_TI}} Max length N of Tenant Name taken from the existing Add Tenant form / API contract.
cases.data: Tenant Name lengths: 1, N-1, N, N+1 characters; other fields per {{TD}}
s: {{OPEN}}
Enter a 1-character Tenant Name with valid other fields and click 'Save & Next'
Create another tenant with an N-character name
Try another tenant with an N+1-character name
cases.e: Names of length 1 and N are saved as Pending tenants and shown untruncated in the Tenants list and workflow header; N+1 is blocked (maxlength or validation message) and not persisted.

cases.sc: Tenant Information - Whitespace Only And Padded Names
cases.cond: Whitespace-only names are rejected and surrounding spaces are trimmed
s: {{OPEN}}
Enter Tenant Name of only spaces with valid other fields and click 'Save & Next'
Change Tenant Name to the padded value and click 'Save & Next'
Open the Tenants list and search the name
cases.e: Whitespace-only name is rejected as empty; padded name is saved trimmed ('QA_TGO_Pad_<...>') with status Pending.

cases.sc: Tenant Information - Tenant Description Optional And Long
cases.cond: Tenant Description empty and long values behave per the existing form
cases.data: Tenant Description: <blank>; then 500+ character text with line breaks and special characters (& < > " ')
s: {{OPEN}}
Fill Tenant Name and Trilogy Go Domain, leave Tenant Description blank and click 'Save & Next'
Return to Tenant Information and enter the long description, click 'Save & Next'
Re-open Tenant Information
cases.e: Blank description is accepted if optional in the existing form (else a required message is shown); the long description is saved up to the field limit (limit enforced, no silent truncation) and special characters display exactly as entered.

cases.sc: Duplicate Tenant - Existing Tenant Name Rejected
cases.cond: A tenant that already exists cannot be created again through the workflow
cases.data: Tenant Name: <exact name of the existing Active tenant>; Trilogy Go Domain: trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com
s: {{OPEN}}
Enter the existing tenant's name and a valid Trilogy Go Domain
Click 'Save & Next'
Open the Tenants list and filter by that name
cases.e: A duplicate-tenant error is shown; user stays on Tenant Information; only the original tenant exists (no new Pending record) and the original tenant's status stays Active.

cases.sc: Duplicate Tenant - Case And Space Variants
cases.cond: Duplicate detection handles case and surrounding-space variants
s: {{OPEN}}
Enter 'qa_tgo_dup_01' with a valid Trilogy Go Domain and click 'Save & Next'
Repeat with 'QA_TGO_DUP_01'
Repeat with ' QA_TGO_Dup_01 '
cases.e: Each variant is treated consistently with the existing duplicate rule (rejected if names are case-insensitive unique); the padded variant is always rejected after trimming; no near-duplicate Pending tenants are created unintentionally (record the rule observed).

cases.sc: Security - XSS Payload In Tenant Fields
cases.cond: Script payloads in Tenant Name/Description are stored and rendered as text
cases.data: Tenant Name: QA_XSS_; Tenant Description:
s: {{OPEN}}
Enter the payloads from Test Data with a valid Trilogy Go Domain and click 'Save & Next'
Open the Tenants list
Re-open the tenant's Tenant Information tab
cases.e: Either the input is rejected by validation or it is saved and rendered HTML-encoded as literal text in the list, workflow header and form; no script executes and no alert dialog appears.

cases.sc: Security - SQL Injection String In Tenant Name
cases.cond: SQL/NoSQL meta characters are treated as literal data
cases.data: Tenant Name: QA_SQLi' OR '1'='1; Tenant Description: {"$gt":""}
s: {{OPEN}}
Enter the Test Data values with a valid Trilogy Go Domain and click 'Save & Next'
Open the Tenants list and search for 'QA_SQLi'
cases.e: Request is rejected by validation or saved as literal text; no server error (500), no extra/other tenants exposed in the list and existing tenants are unchanged.

cases.sc: AC2 - Save And Next Saves Tenant And Advances
cases.cond: Valid Tenant Information is saved and the workflow advances to Regions/Sites
s: {{OPEN}}
{{FILLTI}}
Click 'Save & Next'
Open the Tenants list in a new browser tab and search the Tenant Name
cases.e: Success feedback is shown, the Regions/Sites tab becomes active, and the tenant appears exactly once in the Tenants list with the entered Name, Description and Trilogy Go Domain.

cases.sc: AC2 - Rapid Double Click On Save And Next
cases.cond: Multiple rapid Save & Next clicks create only one tenant
s: {{OPEN}}
{{FILLTI}}
Double/triple-click 'Save & Next' rapidly
Open the Tenants list and search the Tenant Name
cases.e: Button is disabled/ignored while saving; exactly one Pending tenant exists; no duplicate-name error or 500 is displayed to the user.

cases.sc: AC2 - Save And Next Fails On Server Or Network Error
cases.cond: A failed save keeps the user on the step with data retained and creates no partial tenant
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{BC_TI}} Browser DevTools available to set 'Offline' or block the tenant save request (ref. Bug 1476792 - 500 on Create Tenant).
s: {{OPEN}}
{{FILLTI}}
In DevTools set Network to Offline (or block the save request)
Click 'Save & Next'
Restore the network and click 'Save & Next' again
Open the Tenants list and search the Tenant Name
cases.e: On failure a clear error is shown, the user stays on Tenant Information and entered values are retained; after retry the tenant is saved once as Pending and the workflow advances; no orphan/partial tenant exists from the failed attempt.

cases.sc: AC2 - Back To Tenant Information Edit And Save Again
cases.cond: Re-saving a completed step updates the same tenant
cases.data: {{TD}}; updated Tenant Description: QA onboarding workflow test - updated
s: {{OPEN}}
{{FILLTI}} and click 'Save & Next'
Click the 'Tenant Information' tab
Verify saved values are prefilled, change Tenant Description to the updated value
Click 'Save & Next'
Open the Tenants list and search the Tenant Name
cases.e: Saved values are prefilled on return; the update is saved to the same tenant (same Tenant ID); exactly one tenant exists with the updated description and status Pending; workflow is on Regions/Sites.

cases.sc: Navigation - Leave Workflow With Unsaved Changes
cases.cond: Leaving with unsaved changes warns the user and the prompt is responsive
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{BC_TI}} (ref. Bug 1459456 - unresponsive Leave/Stay popup on Manage Service End Point).
s: {{OPEN}}
{{FILLTI}} without saving
Click another side-menu item (e.g. Sites or Activity Report)
If a Leave/Stay prompt appears click 'Stay'
Click the menu item again and choose 'Leave'
cases.e: A leave/stay confirmation (if implemented per Trilogy pattern) is shown and both buttons respond; 'Stay' keeps entered data; 'Leave' navigates away and no tenant is created from the unsaved data. If no prompt exists, unsaved data is discarded and no tenant is created (record behaviour).

cases.sc: AC3 - New Tenant Saved With Pending Status
cases.cond: First save of a new tenant sets status Pending
s: {{OPEN}}
{{FILLTI}} and click 'Save & Next'
Navigate to the Tenants list
Locate the new tenant and read its Status
Refresh the page and read the Status again
cases.e: The new tenant shows Status = Pending (not Active) before and after refresh.

cases.sc: AC3 - Pending Tenant Not Active Immediately
cases.cond: A Pending tenant is not treated as Active anywhere in TGO
s: Navigate to https://trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com/tgo and log in
Click 'Tenants' and filter/sort by Status if available
Open the Pending tenant and check the header/status badge
Check any Active-only views/filters (e.g. Active filter, tenant selectors)
cases.e: The tenant is listed only as Pending, is excluded from Active-only filters/counts, and no action or view shows it as Active.

cases.sc: AC3 - Pending Status Persisted In Backend
cases.cond: Tenant lifecycle state Pending is stored for the new tenant record
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{PENDING}} Read access to the TGO tenant store (lifecycle state field from US 1411909) or the tenant GET API via DevTools.
cases.data: Tenant ID of the Pending tenant
s: Open DevTools Network tab and open the Pending tenant in the Tenants list
Inspect the tenant GET response
Query the tenant record in the TGO tenant store by Tenant ID
cases.e: API response and stored record both show lifecycle state Pending (not Active/null); Name, Description and Trilogy Go Domain match the UI entries.

cases.sc: AC4 - Complete Onboarding Multiple Regions Becomes Active
cases.cond: Completing all steps with several Regions/Sites transitions the tenant to Active
cases.data: {{REG}}; Region 2: QA_Region_West / loyalty-atm-a02.purplecheckpoint.com; Sites QA_Site_01 (East), QA_Site_02 (West)
s: {{OPENP}}
On Regions/Sites click 'Add Region' and save QA_Region_East
Add Region QA_Region_West
Add Site QA_Site_01 under QA_Region_East and QA_Site_02 under QA_Region_West
Click the final completion action ('Save & Next' / Finish / Complete)
Open the Tenants list and read the Status
cases.e: Onboarding completes with a success message; the tenant status changes from Pending to Active and both Regions with their Sites are shown in the hierarchy.

cases.sc: AC4 - Minimum One Region One Site Activates Tenant
cases.cond: The minimum Region/Site configuration activates the tenant
s: {{OPENP}}
Add one Region from Test Data
Add one Site under that Region
Click the final completion action
Open the Tenants list and read the Status
cases.e: With exactly one Region and one Site the tenant becomes Active (if the build requires more, record the actual minimum and raise against REQ-004 ambiguity).

cases.sc: AC4 - No Region Keeps Tenant Pending
cases.cond: Tenant Information only (no Region) cannot activate the tenant
cases.data: Decision rule: Tenant Info = Y, Region = N, Site = N
s: {{OPENP}}
On Regions/Sites (no Regions) click the final completion action if enabled
Open the Tenants list and read the Status
cases.e: Completion is disabled or blocked with a message that at least one Region/Site is required; status remains Pending.

cases.sc: AC4 - Region Without Site Keeps Tenant Pending
cases.cond: A Region without any Site does not satisfy onboarding requirements
cases.data: Decision rule: Tenant Info = Y, Region = Y, Site = N; {{REG}}
s: {{OPENP}}
Add one Region from Test Data and do not add any Site
Click the final completion action if enabled
Open the Tenants list and read the Status
cases.e: Completion is blocked with a Site-required message and status remains Pending (if the build activates here, log as discrepancy vs assumption A1 for PO confirmation).

cases.sc: Lifecycle - Active Tenant Loses Last Site
cases.cond: Status behaviour when an Active tenant's only Site is soft-deleted is defined and consistent
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} A tenant activated through the new workflow with exactly one Region and one Site. {{BC_RS}}
cases.data: Tenant from TC activating with minimum config
s: {{OPENP}}
On Regions/Sites delete the only Site (soft delete) and confirm
Open the Tenants list and read the Status
Try deleting the Region
cases.e: Behaviour is consistent and recorded: the tenant either stays Active or reverts to Pending as per PO decision (Missing Requirement); Region deletion is allowed only when no Sites remain (US 1411893); no error/500 occurs.

cases.sc: Bypass - Status Cannot Be Set Manually
cases.cond: Pending status cannot be changed to Active via editable controls
s: {{OPENP}}
On Tenant Information and on the tenant list row look for any Status field/toggle/action
If any status control exists attempt to set it to Active and save
cases.e: Status is read-only (no control) or the change is rejected; tenant remains Pending.

cases.sc: Bypass - Direct API Activation Of Incomplete Tenant
cases.cond: Backend rejects activation of a tenant with incomplete onboarding
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{PENDING}} Tenant update/onboarding-state API request captured from DevTools while saving Tenant Information (endpoint not documented in intake).
cases.data: Captured request with lifecycle/status value changed to Active
s: Replay the captured tenant update/onboarding-state request with status/state = Active using Postman and the same auth token
Send the request
Open the Tenants list and read the Status
cases.e: API returns a 4xx validation/forbidden error (not 200, not 500); tenant remains Pending.

cases.sc: Bypass - Deep Link To Regions Sites Step
cases.cond: Direct URL to a later step cannot skip required steps or expose other data
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{PENDING}} Regions/Sites URL of the Pending tenant copied from the address bar.
cases.data: Copied Regions/Sites URL; same URL with a non-existent tenant ID; same URL with no tenant ID
s: Open a new Add Tenant workflow and, without saving, paste the Regions/Sites URL pattern with no tenant ID
Paste the URL with a non-existent tenant ID
Paste the valid Pending tenant URL
cases.e: No-ID and invalid-ID URLs redirect to Tenant Information or show a not-found message without creating data or errors; the valid URL opens the Pending tenant's Regions/Sites step normally.

cases.sc: Navigation - Browser Back After Save And Next
cases.cond: Browser back/forward does not resubmit or duplicate the tenant
s: {{OPEN}}
{{FILLTI}} and click 'Save & Next'
Press the browser Back button
Click 'Save & Next' on the shown form
Press Forward, then open the Tenants list
cases.e: Back shows the saved tenant data (not a blank new-tenant form that creates a second record); re-saving updates the same tenant; exactly one Pending tenant exists.

cases.sc: AC5 - Resume Pending Tenant At Next Step
cases.cond: A Pending tenant reopens at the next incomplete step with saved data prefilled
s: Navigate to https://trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com/tgo and log in
Click 'Tenants' and navigate to another menu (e.g. Activity Report), then back to 'Tenants'
Open the Pending tenant (Edit / Continue Onboarding)
Click the 'Tenant Information' tab
cases.e: Workflow opens on the next incomplete step (Regions/Sites); Tenant Information shows the saved Name, Description and Trilogy Go Domain; status still Pending.

cases.sc: AC5 - Progress Persists Across Logout And Browser
cases.cond: Onboarding progress persists across sessions and browsers
s: In Chrome log in to https://trilogy-go-qa01.purplecheckpoint.com/tgo, click 'Tenants' and open the Pending tenant
Add a Region from Test Data (no Site)
Log out and close the browser
In Edge log in to /tgo and open the same tenant from 'Tenants'
cases.e: In the new session/browser the tenant is Pending, opens on Regions/Sites and shows the saved Region; Tenant Information values are intact (server-side persistence, not local storage).

cases.sc: AC5 - Pending Tenants Identifiable In Tenants List
cases.cond: Users can find Pending tenants and an action to continue onboarding
cases.data: One Pending and one Active tenant
s: Navigate to /tgo and click 'Tenants'
Compare the Pending and Active rows (status column/badge, row actions)
Use search/filter/sort on status if available
cases.e: Pending and Active tenants are clearly distinguished by status; the Pending row offers an action to continue onboarding; filter/sort by status (if present) returns correct rows.

cases.sc: AC5 - Session Timeout During Regions Step
cases.cond: Session expiry mid-step keeps saved data and loses only unsaved input
cases.pre: {{ENV}} {{ADMIN}} {{PENDING}} {{BC_RS}} Ability to expire the session (wait for timeout or delete the auth cookie/token in DevTools).
s: {{OPENP}}
Click 'Add Region' and fill the modal without saving
Expire the session
Click Save in the modal
Log in again and open the tenant
cases.e: User is sent to login (or shown a session-expired message) without a 500; after re-login the tenant is Pending with previously saved data intact; the unsaved Region is absent or saved once - never duplicated or partially saved.

cases.sc: Concurrency - Two Admins Onboard Same Tenant
cases.cond: Concurrent edits on one Pending tenant do not lose data or double-activate
cases.pre: {{ENV}} Two Admin users (A in Chrome, B in Edge). {{PENDING}} {{BC_RS}}
cases.data: A adds QA_Region_East; B adds QA_Region_West + QA_Site_02
s: User A and User B both open the same Pending tenant on Regions/Sites
User A adds QA_Region_East
User B (without refresh) adds QA_Region_West with QA_Site_02 and completes onboarding
Both users refresh
cases.e: Both Regions exist (no lost update) and the tenant is Active exactly once; stale screens refresh or show a conflict message instead of overwriting data.

cases.sc: Browser Refresh Mid Workflow Keeps Step
cases.cond: Refreshing the page keeps the current step and saved data
s: {{OPENP}}
Add a Region from Test Data
Press F5 on the Regions/Sites tab
cases.e: After reload the same tenant is shown on Regions/Sites with the saved Region; no redirect to a blank new-tenant form; status Pending.

cases.sc: AC7 - Regions Sites Empty State With Add Region
cases.cond: New tenant Regions/Sites step shows empty state and Add Region
s: {{OPENP}}
Observe the Regions/Sites tab content
cases.e: An empty-state message indicating no Regions exist is displayed with an 'Add Region' action; no Sites of other tenants are listed.

cases.sc: AC7 - Add Region Within Onboarding
cases.cond: A Region can be created from the onboarding Regions/Sites step

Click 'Add Region'
Verify the modal fields and fill Region Name, Trilogy Base URL and Region Description from Test Data
Click Save in the modal
cases.e: Modal (Offer Maker pattern) shows Region Name, Trilogy Base URL and Region Description; on save the Region appears as a parent row in the nested grid of this tenant; tenant stays Pending.

cases.sc: AC7 - Add Site Under Region And Expand Collapse
cases.cond: A Site can be added under a Region and the hierarchy expands/collapses

Click the inline 'Add Site' action on QA_Region_East
Fill the Site fields from Test Data and save
Collapse and expand QA_Region_East
cases.e: Site is shown as a child row under QA_Region_East; collapse hides it and expand shows it again; existing Site fields are available in the Site modal.

cases.sc: Region Site Rule - Site Cannot Be Created Without Region

Look for any Add Site action on the empty Regions/Sites step

cases.e: No Add Site action is available without a Region, or saving is blocked with a 'Region is required' message; no Site record is created.

s: Replay the Site create request without Region reference
Replay it with another tenant's Region ID
Reload the tenant's Regions/Sites step
cases.e: Both requests are rejected with 4xx validation errors; no orphan or cross-tenant Site appears in either tenant's hierarchy.

cases.sc: Region Rule - Duplicate Region Name In Same Tenant

Click 'Add Region' and enter the duplicate Region Name
Click Save

Add Region QA_Region_East with a valid Trilogy Base URL
Open Tenant X hierarchy

Add Region 'qa_region_east' and save
Add Region 'QA_Region_East ' and save

cases.sc: Region Modal - Required Fields Validation

cases.sc: AC7 Navigation Refactor - Region Site Not Disconnected

Open the existing tenant from 'Tenants'
Open its Regions/Sites tab
If a standalone Sites page still exists, open it and compare the data for the same tenant
cases.e: Regions and Sites of the tenant are managed from the tenant's Regions/Sites tab; any remaining standalone page shows the same hierarchy/data (no conflicting or disconnected lists).

Compare every tenant in the pre-deployment snapshot with the list

Open the 'Regions/Sites' tab and expand all Regions

Open the latest request trace

Change Tenant Description and click 'Save & Next' (or Save)

Query all site records and their Region reference
Query Regions and their Tenant reference

cases.cond: Tenant creation and Pending->Active transition are traceable

Open the tenant selector and search for the Pending tenant

Expand all Regions
